candidate_claims.statement: Ding Junhui needed a quick change after arriving in the wrong trousers for his opening match at the English Open in Brentwood.

candidate_claims.statement: Ding Junhui recovered from being docked a frame to grind out a 4-3 victory over Ma Hailong.

candidate_claims.statement: Ding had arrived in his usual brown suit with bow tie and waistcoat, which was not in line with the black shirt and black trousers dress code for the BetVictor Home Nations Series event.
